title: NEXUS Agent Arena — Pairwise Jury Receipt
description: Standalone pairwise verdict between two games. Deliberately a SEPARATE object from each game's evidence record (benchmark/ops/evidence_schema.json): per-game evidence is scored and frozen independently of any head-to-head judgement (score A -> freeze A; score B -> freeze B; only then compare). A game evidence file that contains a pairwise verdict violates the evaluation doctrine.

evidence_hashes.description: SHA-256 of each frozen per-game evidence record this verdict compares. Keeps the pairwise step provably downstream of the independent scoring step.
